note: Representations below are simplified shapes of the real types at the pinned SHA, not verbatim dumps.

steps.narrative: The user types 'help me refactor foo.ts'. AgentSession.prompt() validates the model and auth, expands skill commands and prompt templates, and lets input hooks transform the text. If the agent is already streaming, the message is queued via steer() (interrupt) or followUp() (wait).
steps.title: Input

steps.narrative: Extensions may edit the system-prompt options (before_agent_start). The structured sections are diffed against the transcript and only changed sections are emitted; tool declarations ride as toolsAdded/toolsRemoved deltas on the system message.
steps.title: Prompt assembly

steps.narrative: Agent.prompt() → runAgentLoop() → the app's streamFn, which delegates to modelRuntime.streamSimple(): token streaming from whichever of ~35 providers is selected, over SSE or WebSocket.
steps.title: Model call

steps.narrative: Streaming events assemble the partial assistant message in context. Tool calls are extracted from assistant content blocks of type toolCall. If the model stops on output length, tool calls are NOT executed — each gets an error result, since arguments may be truncated.
steps.title: Response parsing

steps.narrative: Sequential or parallel. Per call: tool lookup → argument preparation → TypeBox schema validation → beforeToolCall (extensions may block) → execute → afterToolCall (extensions may rewrite the result).
steps.representation:
runToolCall(toolCall)
  1. prepareToolCall — lookup "read", validate args
  2. beforeToolCall — extension hooks may block
  3. tool.execute(id, args, signal, onUpdate)
  4. afterToolCall  — extension hooks may rewrite result
steps.title: Tool dispatch

steps.narrative: Each result becomes a toolResult message appended to the transcript. The inner loop then issues the next provider request with the enriched context.
steps.representation:
ToolResultMessage {
  role: "toolResult",
  toolCallId: "call_1",
  toolName: "read",
  content: [{ type: "text", text: "<foo.ts contents>" }],
  isError: false
}
steps.title: Tool-result feedback

steps.narrative: The turn ends when no tool calls, steering, or follow-up messages remain, when finishTurn returns {action: "end"}, or when every result in a batch sets terminate: true. There is no max-iteration limit anywhere in the loop — the model's own stopping behavior is the bound.
steps.representation:
finishTurn({ message, toolResults, context })
  → { action: "end" }      // stop now
  → { action: "continue" }  // explicit continuation
  → undefined                // natural termination
// + steering / follow-up queue drains
steps.title: Termination decision

steps.narrative: Every state change is a typed AgentEvent. The Agent reduces events into state and forwards them to subscribers; the TUI, RPC server, and print mode all render purely from this stream. There is no privileged renderer.
steps.title: Rendering
